description.label: Description
description.value:
Minor Mental Mutation

Your mind is wiped clean by the corruption of Chaos and you cannot remember who you are or what you've experienced before the moment you gained this mutation. You retain all your skills and topical knowledge, such as etiquette and geography, but you can't remember how you learned it or your relation to people or places that you know of. If you gain this mutation a second time you will wake up every morning with your memories erased. Gaining the mutation a third time will cause your memory to be erased every hour. You cannot gain the mutation more than three times.
